scope: Open Legend roleplay and low-refusal LLM research

priority_semantics.P1: High research interest for a selected question; not a required initial panel, measured winner or readiness/rights assessment
priority_semantics.P3: Lower-interest/watchlist coverage; availability and rights remain separate

hardware_estimate_method: Idealized raw 4-bit weight bytes=parameters×0.5; excludes overhead and KV cache

baseline_references.name: DeepHermes 3 Mistral 24B Preview
baseline_references.reason: Collection update 2025-03-13; retain only as a hybrid-reasoning historical control. Hermes 4.3 is the newer documented Nous comparison.

baseline_references.name: Magnum v4 family
baseline_references.reason: Publisher profile lists 123B/72B and smaller releases updated 2024-11-25. Useful prose controls, but recent quant repacks do not make the underlying models current. Exact variant license must be checked.

baseline_references.name: Euryale L3.3 70B v2.3
baseline_references.reason: Publisher profile shows 2024-12-08 generation. Do not market it as a new 2026 Stheno successor merely because quants were uploaded later.

baseline_references.name: Midnight Miqu 70B v1.5
baseline_references.reason: Author collection updated 2024-12-10; old foundation and unclear commercial lineage make it a historical style reference, not a preferred new production dependency. Same author now has Glistening Gem 2.1.

baseline_references.name: RimDialogue 3B v1
baseline_references.reason: Historical game-NPC-specific Llama 3.2 example. Card says the associated mod was taken down by Ludeon; useful evidence of actual game-dialogue use, not a current integration recommendation.

baseline_references.name: Behemoth X 123B v2.2
baseline_references.reason: Card identifies Mistral Large 2411 lineage. A recent upload is not a contemporary foundation; newer Behemoth 128B v3 is tracked separately, with weak WIP evidence.

review_scope: All original 34 candidates expanded with artifact-specific hosting research; exact project-selected Huihui 4B pin added as RP35. Prior sentiment/examples retain original dates. This pass is not a new full-market opinion scan or model evaluation.

hosting_review.context_method: Exact config-position ceilings are separate optional config_max_position_embeddings_tokens fields. Native/extended values require their stated parent/card scope. Runtime defaults, output maxima and actual deployed caps are not inferred; unknown remains null.
hosting_review.memory_method: Decimal GB for tensor/file arithmetic; GiB for explicit KV examples. Rounded full-repository totals, tensor-index payload and selected packed files are identified separately. No number is measured VRAM/host RAM unless attributed as publisher evidence. Total MoE weights, lookup tables, vision/MTP and runtime state are considered; active parameters are not storage.
hosting_review.storage_method: artifact_size_gb records a selected packed-file footprint, repository acquisition size or tensor-payload floor, with scope explicit in basis. disk_gb is null because complete container/cache/temp/conversion/operating allocations were not published or proposed. Exact artifact_bytes remains null where only rounded listing sizes or tensor payload metadata were available.
hosting_review.compatibility_method: Primary model config/card/runtime evidence; architecture registry support is a lead, not exact derivative qualification. Serialization transformers_version and autogenerated HF examples do not establish working runtime versions.
hosting_corrections: RP03: exact named Venice HF repository has no weights/config; self-hosting unverified.
RP26: current manually gated access plus mixed-precision 510 GB artifact and separate conversion/offload dependencies.
RP28: Kyojin hooks required; newer CUDA port exists, exact GLM pack fit remains unverified.
RP35: previously imported external vLLM route and managed MODEL_SERVING_IMAGE qualification remain distinct.
hosting_review.date_basis: Date-only review, addition and retrieval dates use America/New_York (2026-10-25); the retrieval session crossed UTC midnight into 2026-10-26. Publisher event dates are preserved.
